title: Cooperative action of separate interaction domains promotes high-affinity DNA binding of Arabidopsis thaliana ARF transcription factors
authors: Mattia Fontana; Mark Roosjen; Isidro Crespo García; Willy van den Berg; Marc Malfois; Roeland Boer; Dolf Weijers; Johannes Hohlbein
one_liner_zh: 该文用smFRET定量研究拟南芥ARF转录因子DBD与PB1结构域协同结合DNA的动力学与亲和力，虽聚焦TF-DNA互作但方法为单分子实验而非AI/物理模拟，故给6分。
abstract: The signaling molecule auxin is pivotal in coordinating many growth and development processes in plants mainly through the modulation of gene expression. The transcriptional response to auxin is mediated by the family of auxin response factors (ARF). Monomers of this family recognize a DNA motif (TGTC[TC]/[GG]) called the auxin-response element (AuxRE). ARFs can homodimerize through their DNA binding domains (DBD) thereby enabling cooperative binding for a bipartite inverted AuxRE (IR7). In addition to the DBD, most ARFs contain a C-terminal Phox and Bem1p (PB1) domain both capable of homotypic interactions, and mediating interactions with Aux/IAA repressors. Given the dual role of the PB1 domain, and the ability of both DBD and PB1 domain to mediate dimerization, a key question is how each of these domains contributes to conferring DNA-binding specificity and affinity. So far, ARF-ARF and ARF-DNA interactions have mostly been approached using qualitative methods that do not provide a quantitative and dynamic view on the binding equilibria. Here, we utilize a DNA binding assay based on single-molecule Förster resonance energy transfer (smFRET) to study the affinity and kinetics of the interaction of several Arabidopsis thaliana ARFs with an IR7 AuxRE. We show that both DBD and PB1 domains of AtARF2 contribute toward DNA binding, and we identify ARF dimer stability as a key parameter in defining affinity and kinetics seen for the DBDs of different AtARFs. Lastly, we derived an analytical solution for a four-state cyclic model that explains both the kinetics and the affinity of the interaction between AtARF2 and IR7. Our work demonstrates that the affinity of ARFs towards composite DNA response elements can be tuned by small changes of their dimerization equilibrium suggesting that this effect has major implications for ARF-mediated transcriptional activity.
abstract_zh: 信号分子生长素主要通过调控基因表达，在植物许多生长和发育过程中起关键作用。对生长素的转录响应由生长素响应因子（ARF）家族介导。该家族的单体识别一个称为生长素响应元件（AuxRE）的DNA基序（TGTC[TC]/[GG]）。ARFs可通过其DNA结合域（DBD）形成同源二聚体，从而实现对二分反向AuxRE（IR7）的协同结合。除DBD外，大多数ARFs含有一个C端Phox和Bem1p（PB1）结构域，该结构域既能进行同型相互作用，也能介导与Aux/IAA抑制因子的相互作用。鉴于PB1结构域的双重角色，以及DBD和PB1结构域均能介导二聚化，一个关键问题是这些结构域各自如何贡献于DNA结合特异性和亲和力。迄今为止，ARF-ARF和ARF-DNA相互作用大多采用定性方法研究，这些方法无法提供结合平衡的定量和动态视角。在此，我们利用基于单分子福斯特共振能量转移（smFRET）的DNA结合实验，研究拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）多种ARFs与IR7 AuxRE相互作用的亲和力和动力学。我们表明，AtARF2的DBD和PB1结构域均有助于DNA结合，并确定ARF二聚体稳定性是定义不同AtARFs DBDs所观察到的亲和力和动力学的关键参数。最后，我们推导了一个四态循环模型的解析解，该模型解释了AtARF2与IR7相互作用的动力学和亲和力。我们的工作表明，ARFs对复合DNA响应元件的亲和力可通过其二聚化平衡的微小变化进行调节，提示这一效应对ARF介导的转录活性具有重要影响。
